$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} \int_{2}^{4} r^{3} \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\,\mathrm d r\,\mathrm d \theta & = \int_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} \cos{\left(\theta \right)} \int_{2}^{4} r^{3}\,\mathrm d r\,\mathrm d \theta \\

& = \int_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} \cos{\left(\theta \right)} \left(\frac{\left(4\right)^{4}-\left(2\right)^{4}}{4}\right)\,\mathrm d \theta \\
& = \int_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} 60 \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\,\mathrm d \theta
\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we integrate with respect to $\theta :$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} 60 \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\,\mathrm d \theta & = \left[60 \sin{\left(\theta \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} \\
& = \left(\left(60 \sin{\left(\left(\frac{2 \pi}{3}\right) \right)}\right)\right)-\left(\left(60 \sin{\left(\left(0\right) \right)}\right)\right) \\
& = \left(\left(30 \sqrt{3}\right)\right)-\left(\left(0\right)\right) \\
& = 30 \sqrt{3}
\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["3a3caee0-7ffe-5ece-9043-3c72c75bc2b1"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "5b31a55b-0e08-5b10-90d3-f415dd61d532" :answer/id #uuid "5b31a55b-0e08-5b10-90d3-f415dd61d532" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{40 \sqrt{2}}{9}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4fe657c8-5093-56cf-9869-20f9d4045c19" :answer/id #uuid "4fe657c8-5093-56cf-9869-20f9d4045c19" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2 + \pi" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "29076542-9b82-5313-ab48-11cd7c4ee9c7" :answer/id #uuid "29076542-9b82-5313-ab48-11cd7c4ee9c7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{1}{2} + \frac{\pi}{4}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "93db2af4-05d1-5ccd-83ce-6076e2bd6836" :answer/id #uuid "93db2af4-05d1-5ccd-83ce-6076e2bd6836" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "- \frac{\pi}{2} - 1" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4b44810b-e430-58ae-98d3-e30826cb8054" :answer/id #uuid "4b44810b-e430-58ae-98d3-e30826cb8054" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "1 + \frac{\pi}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fa93751a-e6cc-5420-b729-3e05bf739c8d" :answer-field/id #uuid "fa93751a-e6cc-5420-b729-3e05bf739c8d" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["5b31a55b-0e08-5b10-90d3-f415dd61d532" "4fe657c8-5093-56cf-9869-20f9d4045c19" "29076542-9b82-5313-ab48-11cd7c4ee9c7" "93db2af4-05d1-5ccd-83ce-6076e2bd6836" "4b44810b-e430-58ae-98d3-e30826cb8054"] :answer-field/correct "4b44810b-e430-58ae-98d3-e30826cb8054" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "a9777f92-2c4b-5b38-b0d9-df6bb94b4ee3" :question/id #uuid "a9777f92-2c4b-5b38-b0d9-df6bb94b4ee3" :question/problem "Evaluate $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \int_{0}^{4 \cos{\left(2 \theta \right)}} r\,\mathrm d r\,\mathrm d \theta.$" :question/worked-solution "First, we integrate with respect to $r,$ treating $\theta $ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \int_{0}^{4 \cos{\left(2 \theta \right)}} r\,\mathrm d r\,\mathrm d \theta & = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \left[\frac{r^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{4 \cos{\left(2 \theta \right)}}\,\mathrm d \theta \\
& = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \left(\frac{\left(4 \cos{\left(2 \theta \right)}\right)^{2}-\left(0\right)^{2}}{2}\right)\,\mathrm d \theta \\

\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\cos(2x)=2\cos^2 x-1.
$$

$$
\cos^2\left(2\theta\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(1+\cos\left(4\theta\right)\right).

$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} 8 \cos^{2}{\left(2 \theta \right)}\,\mathrm d \theta & = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} 4\left(1+\cos\left(4\theta\right)\right)\,\mathrm d \theta \\
& = 4\left[\theta + \frac{\sin{\left(4 \theta \right)}}{4}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \\
& = 4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{8}+\frac{1}{4}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\right)-\left(0+\frac{1}{4}\sin\left(0\right)\right)\right) \\
& = 4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{8}+\frac{1}{4} \left(1\right)\right)-\left(0+\frac{1}{4} \left(0\right)\right)\right) \\

\end{aligned}
